name: Sprawling Chaos
body:
School evocation [chaos, mind-affecting]; Level magus 6, sorcerer/wizard 6, unchained summoner 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a shard of broken glass)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect fog spreads in 20-ft. radius, 20 ft. high
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates, see text; Spell Resistance yes see text 30

DESCRIPTION

You create a shifting cloud of chaotic colors and lights that functions like the fog cloud spell. Any creatures passing through the cloud take 2d6 damage from the chaotic psychic energies and if they take damage, they must make a Will save or be confused as per the spell confusion for 1d4 rounds. Additional instances of confusion do not stack, but the duration is extended by the 1d4 rolled. The damage and confusion effect are mind-affecting effects and are subject to spell resistance.

The fog cloud effect is not subject to spell resistance.
